  • Wash your hands, then clean and dry the area.
  • Press one or two drops onto the skin beside the piercing and massage gently.
  • Repeat twice daily. Steady daily use matters more than using a lot at once.

Use Cases

  • Conditioning step after saline spray for a new nose or ear piercing
  • Dry-feeling skin around a cartilage, helix or tragus stud
  • Septum, belly button, navel, eyebrow, lip and dermal piercing routines
  • Skin care around nipple piercings

Care and Safety

  • For external use only.

  • Stop use if any skin reaction occurs.

What is the BodyJ4You Organic Piercing Aftercare Oil Blend used for?

The BodyJ4You Organic Piercing Aftercare Oil Blend moisturizes and conditions the skin around a piercing after cleaning. You apply one or two drops beside the jewelry twice a day.

How long does one bottle of the oil blend last?

One 1 fl oz bottle covers roughly three months of daily care at one or two drops, twice a day.

Which piercings can I use this oil blend on?

It is made for nose, ear, septum, belly button, navel, cartilage, helix, tragus, nipple, dermal, eyebrow and lip piercings.

Does the oil blend replace saline spray?

No. Clean the piercing first with your saline routine, then use the oil blend as the next step; it pairs with BodyJ4You Piercing Aftercare Spray.

The ingredient list is organic jojoba seed oil, caprylic/capric triglyceride, organic tamanu seed oil, organic tea tree leaf oil, organic lavender oil and organic tocopherol (vitamin E). It has no added fragrance, parabens, phthalates, mineral oil, silicone or dyes.

Is the BodyJ4You Organic Piercing Aftercare Oil Blend vegan?

Yes. The oil blend is vegan and cruelty free, small batch filled in a safety sealed amber glass bottle.
